description: Default dweller portraits used when a dweller has no generated image. 1:2 portrait, 2x the legendary 150x300 source size, transparent alpha, WebP RGBA.
source: OpenAI Images API, model gpt-image-2.5-flare, medium quality, transparent background; Lanczos downscale to 300x600.
notes: Portraits use the legendary set's stylized big-head proportions so the square card crop matches. Gen-1 synths are a single genderless bare-endoskeleton asset. Gen-2 synths are humanoid with artificial skin, visible seams and metallic plating, gendered. Gen-3 synths pass as human.
